\begin{document}
The lead is held at chemical potential $\mu$ and inverse temperature $\beta>0$, with occupation
$n_F(\omega) = 1/(e^{\beta(\omega-\mu)}+1)$. Particle-hole symmetry of the occupation gives
\begin{equation}
n_F(-\omega) = 1 - n_F(\omega) .
\label{eq:ph}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
